A closed desktop app no longer drops out of your group. It stays on the Instances page as Inactive until you remove it, in the web interface, the Android app and the browser extension, and the cards on that page all have the same size.

## 🎨 Design

- **The cards on the Instances page are all the same size.** Each one is as wide and as tall as the others, the logo stands in the same place, and the name is shown in full. The kind has a line of its own, and the badges move under a long name.
- **Every device in the picture of the group wears the KnightLoader logo,** with a small badge for what it is: an instance, the desktop app, the Android app or a browser extension. Names in the picture wrap onto two lines instead of being cut short.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A closed desktop app stays on the Instances page.** It keeps its card and its place in the picture, shows Inactive with when it was last seen, and stays until you remove it, also after the server restarts. The Pairing page lists it the same way.
- **The browser extension and the Android app show a closed instance as Inactive** with when it was last seen. A phone that is away reads Inactive in grey instead of a red Not connected.
- **The Android app follows the group by itself.** An instance that joined later, or was closed while the phone joined, shows up without entering the phrase again, and a renamed one shows its new name. An instance you remove on the phone stays off until you enter the phrase again.
- **Every device shows in the picture of the group at every width.** At some window sizes and on the Pairing page, the phones and browsers next to this instance stayed hidden.
- **Instance cards no longer flash red while the page loads.** Until an instance first answers, its card says Checking, and the card of the instance you are on shows Connected right away.
